_readme: Fictional sample archetypes for the public demo.

archetypes.label: Product Management
archetypes.targetRoles: Product Manager / Senior PM - owning a product area, a roadmap, and the metrics it moves.

additionalOverrides.add-skills: Product Management | Roadmapping | Prioritisation | Experimentation | Cross-functional Leadership

archetypes.notes: Lead with shipped products and measurable outcomes; keep one strategy bullet for range.

evidence.label: Composite product management role
evidence.text: We are looking for a Product Manager in Singapore to work with engineering, design and commercial teams. You will own priorities, use data to make decisions, and communicate clearly with senior stakeholders.

archetypes.label: Product Strategy
archetypes.targetRoles: Product Strategy / Growth Strategy Manager - sizing opportunities, shaping bets, and influencing leadership.

additionalOverrides.add-skills: Product Strategy | Opportunity Sizing | Pricing | Executive Stakeholder Management | Research

archetypes.notes: Lead with sizing and pricing work; the MBA-era projects carry real weight here.

evidence.label: Composite product strategy role
evidence.text: We are looking for a Product Strategy in Singapore to work with engineering, design and commercial teams. You will own priorities, use data to make decisions, and communicate clearly with senior stakeholders.

archetypes.label: Project Management
archetypes.targetRoles: Program / Project Manager - delivering cross-functional work on time, within budget and compliance constraints.

additionalOverrides.add-skills: Project and Programme Management | Vendor Management | Compliance Delivery | Budget Management | Agile Delivery

archetypes.notes: Lead with delivery, vendors and compliance; keep one product-outcome bullet.

evidence.label: Composite project management role
evidence.text: We are looking for a Program in Singapore to work with engineering, design and commercial teams. You will own priorities, use data to make decisions, and communicate clearly with senior stakeholders.
